## Purpose

Describe one clear problem and the chosen correction.

## Evidence

- [ ] The problem is reproduced on the base revision.
- [ ] The correction passes on the candidate revision.
- [ ] Existing tests pass.
- [ ] New behavior has tests.
- [ ] The Patch Passport is attached or linked.

## Risk review

- [ ] No secret or private data is included.
- [ ] New dependencies are listed and justified.
- [ ] New permissions or network access are listed and justified.
- [ ] Changes outside the stated scope are removed.
- [ ] English and Spanish user documentation are updated when needed.

## Responsibility

- [ ] I reviewed and understand every submitted line.
- [ ] I disclosed material use of an AI coding tool.
- [ ] I have the right to contribute this work under Apache-2.0.
